The '''Dahgee system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thusa sector/Legends|Thusa sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dahgee]].
